confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate for July 2026 peak season, not checked against live listings. Restaurant anchors are the most reliable; accommodation is least certain because July rates vary widely by area and room type. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the beer anchor (cocktail about 2x beer, wine glass about 1x beer) because direct knowledge of current bar prices is weaker. The fx value (15 Oct 2026, 0.6955) comes from a search-result summary attributed to the RBA overview page; I could not open that page or confirm the figure in a follow-up search.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The estimate reflects Rome's general price level, benchmarked loosely against other major Italian and Western European tourist cities such as Florence and Milan, with July peak-season pricing applied to accommodation.
